meta.title: Coolmath Smash physics constants (reference: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate v13.0.1)

units.distance: Smash units (u). Melee onward: 1 u is estimated at about 1 decimetre
units.angle: degrees, 0 = away from attacker horizontally, 90 = straight up, counter-clockwise; 361 = Sakurai angle

conventions.frame_numbering: frame 1 = first frame of an action; FAF = first actionable frame (total frames + 1)
conventions.y_axis: world +y is up; convert with stages.pixel_mapping
conventions.one_v_one_multiplier: Ultimate multiplies damage TAKEN by 1.2 in 2-player itemless matches, but the knockback formula uses the un-multiplied damage of the current hit, and hitstun/hitlag/shieldstun ignore it. All test vectors set one_v_one_multiplier_applied=false.

meta.how_to_use: Every object holding numbers has a _source key naming entries in the top-level 'sources' map. Test vectors were generated by verify_script and must reproduce exactly.

sources.params_sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1UdH2L0xi8dO6jyPCcO5e5-8j7SGzezxkeZuF1uP8uOw (community dump of v13.0.1 common/battle_object params; names + descriptions are the sheet's)
sources.verify_script: physics_verify.py, printed in full in physics-reference.md section 'Verification script'; cross-checked against the calc JS (45 vectors, 0 numeric mismatches)
sources.estimate: ESTIMATE by the researcher; reasoning given in physics-reference.md
sources.proposal: DESIGN PROPOSAL for Coolmath Smash, not a measured Ultimate value

variables.p: target % after the hit = pre_percent + damage * stale_mult
variables.d: damage * (1 - (1 - stale_mult) * 0.3)  (Ultimate uses 0.3x of staleness/freshness for d)
variables.r: product of ratios: crouch-cancel 0.85, rage 1.0-1.1, launch rate, etc.

knockback.set_knockback_formula: p = 10, d = wbkb: kb = (((1 + wbkb/2) * 200/(w+100) * 1.4) + 18) * kbg/100 + bkb; ignores %, staleness and rage

constants._source: ssbw_knockback; calc; params_sheet (reaction_damage_mul 1.4, reaction_damage_add 18, reaction_max 2500, damage_max 999, squat_damage_reaction_mul 0.85, mini_jump_attack_mul 0.85)

knockback.test_vectors_note: pre_percent is the displayed % before the hit. Targets: mario w98 g0.087, fox w77 g0.23, bowser w135 g0.125, jigglypuff w68 g0.053. stale_queue = 1-based queue slots holding the move; staleness=false means stale_mult = 1.0 (training mode 'stale off'). expected_vx/vy are magnitudes in u/frame on the first knockback frame and include the tumble gravity bonus. expected_angle_deg is the resolved hitbox angle; expected_effective_angle_deg = atan2(vy, vx).

hitstun.formula: hitstun = floor(max(kb * 0.4, 5)) - 1 ; first actionable frame (unsped) = hitstun + 1

speedup_balloon_knockback.description: For tumble hits (not set-KB), launch is sped up: magnitude lerps 1x..6x as FAF goes 30..80, applied to the first knockback frame and decayed each frame by (faf_initial*0.3 - faf)/(faf_initial*0.3 - faf_initial); real actionable frame = speedup_faf(hitstun+1)

hitstun._source: ssbw_hitstun; ssbw_tumbling; calc; params_sheet (damage_frame_mul 0.4, damage_frame_min 5, damage_level3 32)

launch.decay_note: launch velocity (separate from the fighter's own velocity) loses 0.051 u/frame along its direction each frame; air friction is off during knockback but gravity/fall speed still act on the fighter's own velocity

tumble_gravity_bonus.formula: vy += 5 * (gravity - 0.075) when tumbling and the angle is outside 70-110 deg; not for set-KB

launch.vertical_launch_rules: 70-110 deg tumble: no gravity bonus; fall speed set to 1.8 and gravity to the fighter's DamageFlyTopGravity during hitstun

sakurai_angle._source: ssbw_sakurai; calc (SakuraiAngle, +1 offset per BenArthur_7); params_sheet (damage_angle_ground_reaction_min 60/_max 88, damage_angle_ground_max 38, damage_angle_air 0.663225 rad)

di.applies_to: tumble hits only (calc: di_able requires tumble)

launch._source: ssbw_knockback; calc; params_sheet (damage_speed_mul 0.03, meteor_vector_min 230/_max 310, damage_angle_ground_zero_speed_mul 0.8, invalid_passive_speed 6.0, fly_top_angle_lw 1.22173/_hi 1.91986)

hitlag.formula: hitlag = min(floor((damage*0.65 + 6) * hitlag_mult * electric), 30); crouch-cancel: floor(hitlag*0.67)
hitlag.damage_used: stale damage; the 1v1 multiplier is NOT used
hitlag.multi_player_note: With 3+ players hitlag above 10 frames is scaled down; sources disagree on the exact form (wiki applies a factor to the computed hitlag, calc scales the damage term). 2-player vectors are unaffected.
hitlag._source: ssbw_hitlag; calc (Hitlag); params_sheet (hitstop_frame_mul 0.65, hitstop_frame_add 6, hitstop_frame_max 30, hitstop_elec_mul 1.5, hit_stop_squat_mul 0.67)

shield.break_stun_formula: 400 - percent frames (min 0); mashing removes 3 frames per stick input and 5.4 per button press, then a 33-frame wake-up

shieldstun._source: ssbw_shieldstun; benarthur_shieldstun; calc (ShieldStun); params_sheet (shield_setoff_add 3, shield_setoff_mul 0.8, shield_stiff_mul_attack_4 0.725, shield_stiff_mul_attack_air 0.33, shield_setoff_mul_fighter_shot 0.29)

parry.window_start: first 5 frames of the 11-frame shield drop

shield._source: ssbw_shield; ssbw_stun; params_sheet (shield_max 50, shield_damage_mul 1.19, shield_dec1 0.15, shield_recovery1 0.08, shield_reset 37.5, shield_min_frame 3, guard_off_cancel_frame 0xB, furafura_frame 400, furafura_clatter_frame 3, shield_pattern_power_mul 0.85); ufd_smash (11-frame drop)

slide._note: the slide starts at speed_fresh and the stop energy brakes it by a constant amount a frame along the dodge; distance_fresh and end_speed say it is down to 1.3 after 20 u. Script frame 14 sets SLIDE_ENABLE_GRAVITY in 48 of the 64 dumped EscapeAirSlide game scripts (Mario's has no gravity flag) and frame 24 sets SLIDE_ENABLE_CONTROL in all 64; the mods hand the slide's speed to the control energy (FALL_ADJUST_NO_CAP, so above air speed too) and to gravity
slide._source: param_motion (escape_air_slide_speed, escape_air_slide_penalty_speed, escape_air_slide_end_speed); energy_id (stop.rs, EscapeAirSlide reset); acmd_dump; mod_hdr; mod_wubor; fighter_prc (Mario air_brake_x)

air_dodge_directional.ends_in: not helpless: the fighter can act again from total + 1, but gets no second air dodge before landing, a hit or a ledge grab
air_dodge_directional._source: ufd_mario; ssbw_air_dodge (distance table); mmsp (landing_frame_escape_air_slide_max 20); params_sheet (escape_air_slide_stick 0.66, escape_air_slide_landing_speed_max 2.0)

dodges.air_dodge_refresh: landing, getting hit, or grabbing a ledge

dodge_staling._source: params_sheet (escape_penalty_frame 0x3C, escape_penalty_max_count 5, escape_penalty_recovry_frame 0x78, escape_penalty_motion_rate 0.06, escape_f 0.06, escape_b 0.1, escape_air 0.0)

dodges.frames_note: every frame count here is a total (UFD, SmashWiki); the first actionable frame is total + 1

ledge.intangibility_formula: 60*(min(airtime,300)/300) + 44 - 44*(min(percent,120)/120), min 4, plus the 19-frame catch animation (so 23..123 total)
ledge.no_regrab_meaning_note: cliff_no_catch_frame / damage_cliff_no_catch_frame have no description in the sheet; meaning inferred from names
ledge._source: ssbw_edge; dataviewer (cliff_catch CancelFrame 20); params_sheet (cliff_wait_air_xlu_max_frame 0x3C, cliff_wait_air_xlu_max_air_frame 0x12C, cliff_wait_damage_xlu_max_frame 0x2C, cliff_wait_damage_xlu_max_damage 0x78, cliff_wait_xlu_min_frame 4, cliff_catch_time_quick 0x168, cliff_max_count 6, cliff_back_range_x_mul 0.6, cliff_no_catch_frame 0x2C, damage_cliff_no_catch_frame 0x1E, cliff_catch_cancel_stick_y -0.66)

jump.full_hop_model: frames 1-4 airborne: rise JumpInitialSpeed/4 per frame; then v0 = sqrt(2*g*(JumpHeight - JumpInitialSpeed)) + g/2, v -= g each frame, capped at -fall_speed
jump.model_status: ESTIMATE: reproduces 247/252 UFD airtimes for 65 fighters; see md
jump.short_hop_input: release jump before jumpsquat ends (3 frames), or press two jump buttons / jump+attack macro

fast_fall.allowed_when: tap down while falling (vy <= 0), not while tumbling; vy is set straight to fast_fall_speed with no acceleration; ends on landing, knockback or jump

jump.air_acceleration_formula: accel = base + add * |stick_x|, up to air_speed; air_friction decelerates when no input
jump._source: calc_chars; ufd_stats; ssbw_short_hop; ssbw_air_acceleration; ssbw_wall_jump; params_sheet (jump_initial_frame 4, air_speed_x_limit 2.5, air_speed_y_limit 10.0, mini_jump_attack_mul 0.85)

movement.hold_buffer: a press made any time before the window, held until the window opens, is buffered
movement.walk_max_stick_note: walk speed scales with stick tilt; keyboard needs a walk modifier
movement.b_reverse_note: stick behind the fighter 1 to 4 frames after the special input turns it around and reverses its momentum; behind on the press is a turnaround special (facing only). Neutral, side and down specials; up specials only turn around.
movement._source: ssbw_buffer (9-frame window, hold buffer); params_sheet (precede 7, precede_extension 2, turn_dash_frame 5, dash_speed_keep_frame 6, re_dash_frame 0xF, dash_stick_x 0.85, run_stick_x 0.75); common_prc (turn_run_stick_x -0.6); ufd_stats (Dash and Run Speed, Dash Turnaround); mmsp; ssbw_b_reversing (B-reverse window and momentum); ssbw_side_special (side specials reverse)

tech.reconciliation_note: wiki: 11-frame window, 40-frame lockout; params: passive_trigger_frame 12, no_rapid_frame_value 28. 12 + 28 = 40, so the wiki's 40 is counted from the press (researcher's inference). Use 11 and 40.
tech.tech_speed_note: param invalid_passive_speed = 6.0; the calc uses 6 for walls/ceilings and 3 for floors (speed/0.9 <= 3). Use 6 for walls/ceilings and 3 for floors.
tech._source: ssbw_tech; params_sheet (passive_trigger_frame 0xC, no_rapid_frame_value 0x1C, invalid_passive_speed 6.0, air_escape_passive_trigger_frame 0xF, passive_wall_stop_frame 5)

landing.hard_landing_meaning_note: calc attribute FallingFrameToUseHardLandingLag; meaning inferred from its name
landing.note: param values are lag frames; UFD lists frames until actionable (param + 1)

platforms.drop_input: tap down while standing or walking on a soft platform; not while running, attacking, crouching or shielding (shield-drop is a separate input)
platforms.drop_frames_note: No source gives the platform-drop duration in frames. Proposal: drop on the frame the flick registers and give vy = -0.5.

grab._source: ssbw_grab; ssbw_mash; params_sheet (capture_cut_frame 0x5A, capture_cut_frame_damage 1.7, capture_clatter_frame 8, clatter_button_dec_frame_mul 1.8, invalid_capture_frame 0x3C, capture_cut_damage 10); ufd_stats (Grab Range)

stale_moves.formula: stale_mult = 1 - sum(factors[slot] for each slot holding the move); 1.05 if not in the queue

final_destination.note: main-stage polygon is the same shape as Battlefield's

soft_platforms.path_note: moves horizontally; its path and speed are not in this dataset

pixel_mapping.formula: px = origin_x + x*scale ; py = origin_y - y*scale
pixel_mapping.fits: Battlefield camera box (340 x 210 u) = 1020 x 630 px at 1280x720; main stage = 480 px wide; blast zones sit off-screen like in Smash

fast_faller.note: highest gravity and fall speed in the cast

floaty.note: lowest gravity and fall speed in the cast

brawlhalla.variable_force_mult_formula: d/100 + d^2/20000 (d = damage after the hit)

multiversus.status: online services shut down 2025-05-30; offline play remains
multiversus.ledges: none; every fighter can wall-cling and wall-cling refreshes jumps
multiversus.air_dodges_note: from a 2022 beta-era guide; not re-checked for the 2024 relaunch
multiversus.dodge_meter: dodges and some actions spend a dodge meter; armor drains it; Season 5: an emptied meter no longer refills over time, a dodge jump costs 1 extra bar
multiversus.team_play: 2v2-first design; support fighters buff/pull/shield allies; team perks stack

proposed_controls.rationale: Brawlhalla preset B maps jump/move to WASD and actions to J/K/L/H; Smash adds shield and smash attacks, so they get L and a modifier key. Keyboards are digital, so walk/tilt need a modifier.
